_comment: Manual spec overrides — the escape hatch when a wrong value is spotted in
production. Keyed by product id (data/catalog.json -> products[].product_id),
then by schema field name (see scraper/specs/schema.py). Overrides are the
highest tier: they beat reference data, vendor payloads, titles and prose.
Values are validated like any other source, so a typo is dropped, not shipped.
